subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Which public `skills.load` contract should OpenClaw expose for opting out of personal `.agents/skills` discovery, if any?
rationale: The fix adds public configuration surface and changes built-in skill-source behavior, while existing per-skill disables and prompt limits do not avoid source discovery or watcher registration.

options.title: Add typed source-disable list
options.body: Expose a narrow `skills.load.disableSources`-style list for built-in source ids and apply it consistently in discovery, watcher registration, status, docs, and tests.

options.title: Add personal-only toggle
options.body: Expose a smaller boolean for `~/.agents/skills` only, reducing API surface but leaving project `.agents/skills` and any future source opt-outs unresolved.

options.title: Decline new config
options.body: Keep current behavior and document per-skill disables, allowlists, and prompt limits as the supported mitigation, accepting continued discovery of personal agent skills.

recommendation.title: Add typed source-disable list
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow `skills.load.disableSources`-style list for built-in source ids and apply it consistently in discovery, watcher registration, status, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a config/product-shape decision on the skills source and watcher surface where steipete has adjacent current history.
